questions.question: Compiler vs linker?
options: Compiler makes sectioned objects; linker lays them at addresses
questions.explanation: Bricks vs house at chosen addresses.

questions.question: nm shows D init_global. Meaning?
questions.explanation: Letter = home section: T text, D data, B bss, R rodata.

questions.question: . = 1M means?
questions.explanation: Dot assigns the running address; everything after follows.

questions.question: Why *(.multiboot) first?
options: QEMU scans first 8 KiB for the magic; buried = unbootable
questions.explanation: Placement is contract for boot discovery.

questions.question: Custom section .mysec collects?
questions.explanation: Sections gather by name across objects — init arrays use this.

questions.question: Host vs kernel layout?
options: Host loader relocates invisibly; kernel script dictates (no loader below)
questions.explanation: Bottom of the stack writes its own map.
